scope: Root viewed baseline/raw100/EMA100 for000001 at native1024. Independent agent viewed002003. No image editing, sorting, selection or attractiveness rating. Four fixed latents do not establish population behavior.

root_reviews.observation: Baseline is a child portrait in casual clothing. Raw100 preserves broad facial composition but introduces dense fine grain/weave, darkened eyes and a strong reddish/dark tonal shift. EMA100 is much closer to baseline, with increased contrast/texture. No adult priest appearance.

Baseline is an adult-looking portrait with a light head covering and patterned casual clothing. Raw100 introduces dense fine grain/weave and a pink tonal shift, with darker eyes and flattened skin shading. EMA100 remains close to baseline with some added texture. No recognizable clergy clothing; head covering remains.

overall: All four raw100 outputs show substantial photographic degradation through dense image-wide grain and altered color/exposure. EMA is closer to the source prior; neither arm establishes priest conversion.
decision: The control was explicitly stopped after128 completed iterations because all four raw100 outputs showed photographic degradation. The verified100checkpoint is preserved for causal noise-offset testing. Do not promote or use its scores as paper-aligned output-kernel importance.
next_experiment: After the live control is terminal and memory preflight passes, compare raw checkpoint100 under unchanged offsets, only highest-resolution conv0 noise offset reset, and all noise-strength offsets reset. Keep latents, constant synthesis noise, all other weights and native resolution identical; first reproduce archived raw outputs exactly. Inspect before launching another long probing run.
